usedFor: Freshsales Suite holds your deals, and Calendly gets a meeting when “Create One-Time Meeting” follows “New Deal Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Created” in Freshsales Suite, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new deal triggers a one-time Calendly meeting, so the first call is set up without chasing.

watchOut: “New Deal Created” is polling, and “Deal Updated” would fire again on each edit, so pick the trigger carefully.
